subject: english
stem: Which reason does the passage give for this situation: “However, students noticed that quieter neighborhoods with older residents had fewer online reports, possibly”?
options: People there did not use the website
You do not use it every day
The teacher could not use the screen
People trust strangers they may never meet

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「people there did not use the website」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「You do not use it every day」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The teacher could not use the screen」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「People trust strangers they may never meet」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「people there did not use the website」，答案為「People there did not use the website」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「People there did not use the website」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
